accessNotes: FIRST-PARTY-ONLY recapture on 2026-08-11. Tradeify's official Pricing Reference is now marked 'Updated this week' and still publishes the same 16 base purchase prices across Growth, Select and Lightning. The homepage promotion is temporary and internally inconsistent: the top banner advertises 40% off for five uses and then 30% off with code AUG through August 31 at 11:59 PM EST, while multiple CTA labels still say 35% off and the server-readable pricing cards contain placeholder values such as repeated $359/$251 prices, '?' targets, Lorem ipsum, $0, and code DASH. None of those promotional or placeholder amounts replaces a base price. The Pricing Reference also publishes a permanent 5-account 5% bundle discount for Growth 25K/50K and Select 25K/50K that can stack with an active promo code; single-account base prices remain the stored comparison values. Select 50K's reset fee is now $109, versus $95 in the 2026-07-28 provenance, but reset fees are not represented by the Challenge schema and no purchase price changed. Select is represented twice because one evaluation branches permanently after passing into materially different Flex and Daily funded risk/payout paths.

accountSizes.evidence: Pricing Reference: Growth 25K is $99 one-time. Growth rules: $1,500 target, $600 soft DLL and $1,000 EOD trailing max drawdown.
Pricing Reference: Growth 50K is $145 one-time. Growth rules: $3,000 target, $1,250 soft DLL and $2,000 EOD trailing max drawdown.
Pricing Reference: Growth 100K is $255 one-time. Growth rules: $6,000 target, $2,500 soft DLL and $3,500 EOD trailing max drawdown.
Pricing Reference: Growth 150K is $369 one-time. Growth rules: $9,000 target, $3,750 soft DLL and $5,000 EOD trailing max drawdown.

notes: BASE LIST PRICES: $99 / $145 / $255 / $369 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. Expiring promotions and the five-account bundle discount are excluded from single-account base prices.
ONE-TIME AND $0 ACTIVATION: Growth has no subscription rebill and no simulated-funded activation fee.
SIX-PERCENT TARGET: $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 by tier.
SOFT DAILY LOSS: $600 / $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,750; reaching it stops trading for the day rather than failing the account by itself.
EOD TRAILING LOSS: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000; tier-specific dollar caps remain in accountSizes rather than a false shared percentage.
ONE-DAY PASS: Growth evaluation has no consistency rule and can pass after one trading day. The 35% stored value is the simulated-funded payout gate.
PAYOUT GATE: every request cycle needs five qualifying profit days with $100 / $150 / $200 / $250 minimum daily profit by tier.
NINETY-PERCENT SPLIT: simulated-funded requests pay 90% to the trader; Elite Live uses 80/20.
DAY TRADING ONLY: positions must close by 4:45 PM ET, so overnight and weekend holding are prohibited.
NEWS ALLOWED: the separate microscalping payout gate requires over 50% of trades and over 50% of profit to come from trades longer than 10 seconds.
AUTOMATION AND COPYING RESTRICTED: a provably personal non-HFT bot is conditional; copy trading is limited to accounts the trader owns and manages.
ALL SALES FINAL: purchases, resets and other fees are non-refundable.
